Selected Food Sources of Selenium
consumers compare the nutrient content of products. The % 
Daily Value (DV) listed on the label indicates the percentage of 
the DV provided in one serving. A food providing 5% of the 
DV or less is a source, whereas a food that provides 10% to 19% 
of the DV is a good source. A food that provides 20% or more 
of the DV is high in that nutrient. It is important to remember 
that foods that provide lower percentages of the DV also con-
tribute to a healthful diet.
